title: Northgate Optical Lab Cancellation Fee Card
content:
| Base-lens charge of the job | Lab cancellation fee |
|---|---|
| 140.00 or more | 10.00 |
| 90.00 up to but not including 140.00 | 7.50 |

**Northgate Optical lab cancellation fee by base-lens charge.** Where the base-lens charge is 140.00 or more, the lab cancellation fee is 10.00, and where it is at least 90.00 but less than 140.00, the fee is 7.50. A base-lens charge below 90.00 is outside this card.

**Which figure.** The base-lens charge of the original order as posted — after any Plus discount, and before any credit against it.

### Applications (hypothetical jobs)

| Job | Base-lens charge as posted | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses | 199.99 | 10.00 |
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses | 149.99 | 10.00 |
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses with a 15 percent Plus discount | 127.49 | 7.50 |
| Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses | 99.99 | 7.50 |
| Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses | 89.99 | outside this card |
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses billed to VSP, with a vision plan allowance credited against the charge | 149.99 | 10.00 |
